class Candidate(c.NodeId id, nat weight, nat minimum)
(nat, nat) priority(Candidate candidate)
    return (candidate.weight, candidate.minimum)
void assign_codes(c.NodeId | none id, string prefix, c.BinaryNodes<nat> nodes, string[] &codes)
    node := nodes.get(id)
    if not nodes.present(node.left)
        codes[node.value] = prefix
        return
    assign_codes(node.left, prefix + "0", nodes, &codes)
    assign_codes(node.right, prefix + "1", nodes, &codes)
source := "she sells sea shells by the sea shore"
frequencies := c.frequencies(source.characters())
leaves := c.sorted_entries(frequencies)
nodes := c.BinaryNodes<nat>()
Candidate[] active := []
for: (_, weight) := leaves[i]
    id := .nodes.add(i)
    .active.push(Candidate(id, weight, i))
while #active > 1
    active = active.sorted_by_pair(priority)
    left := active[0]
    right := active[1]
    minimum := math.min(left.minimum, right.minimum)
    id := .nodes.add(0, left = left.id, right = right.id)
    active = active[2:].append(Candidate(id, left.weight + right.weight, minimum))
codes := array(#leaves, fill = "")
assign_codes(active[0].id, "", nodes, &codes)
nat bits := 0
for: (symbol, weight) := leaves[i]
    bits += weight * #codes[i]
    println("'{symbol}' freq={weight} code={codes[i]}")
println("encoded bits: {bits}{NL}fixed 8-bit: {#source * 8}")
